metadata.programming_language: TypeScript with Shadcn-ui and Tailwind CSS
metadata.author: Emma - Product Manager

original_requirements.description: End-to-End Restaurant Ordering System that handles customer interaction through multiple channels, menu selection with variants, item customization with complex pricing, order processing with validation, and payment confirmation with multiple methods.
key_features: Multiple ordering channels (tablet, smartphone app, QR code)
Complex item customization and pricing calculation
Multiple payment methods and confirmation workflow

product_goals: Streamline restaurant operations by providing a unified ordering system that reduces wait times by 40% and increases order accuracy to 99.5%
Maximize revenue through dynamic pricing strategies and upselling features that increase average order value by 25%
Enhance customer experience by offering flexible ordering channels and personalized recommendations based on dietary preferences and order history

user_stories.story: As a walk-in customer, I want to scan a QR code at my table to access the digital menu so that I can browse options and place my order without waiting for a server
acceptance_criteria: QR code generates unique session linked to table number
Menu loads within 3 seconds on mobile device
Order is automatically assigned to correct table

user_stories.story: As a customer with dietary restrictions, I want to filter menu items by allergens and dietary preferences so that I can safely order food that meets my needs
acceptance_criteria: Filter options include gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, dairy-free, nut-free
Filtered results show only compatible items
Ingredient lists are clearly displayed for each item

user_stories.story: As a customer ordering a pizza, I want to customize size, crust, and toppings with real-time price updates so that I know the exact cost before adding to cart
acceptance_criteria: Price updates instantly with each customization
Visual preview shows selected options
Pricing breakdown is transparent and detailed

user_stories.story: As a restaurant manager, I want to track inventory in real-time and automatically disable unavailable items so that customers cannot order out-of-stock ingredients
acceptance_criteria: Inventory updates across all ordering channels simultaneously
Out-of-stock items are grayed out with clear messaging
Alternative suggestions are provided when possible

user_stories.story: As a customer, I want to split payment between multiple credit cards and include a tip so that I can pay conveniently with my preferred methods
acceptance_criteria: Support for 2+ payment methods per order
Tip calculation with preset percentages (15%, 18%, 20%)
Secure payment processing with PCI compliance

requirements_analysis.overview: The End-to-End Restaurant Ordering System requires a highly scalable, real-time architecture capable of handling multiple concurrent ordering channels while maintaining data consistency across inventory, pricing, and order management systems. The system must support complex business logic for customizations, dynamic pricing calculations, and comprehensive validation workflows.
key_technical_challenges: Real-time synchronization across multiple ordering channels
Complex pricing engine with dynamic calculations
Inventory management with real-time stock tracking
High-performance database design for concurrent operations
Secure payment processing with multiple gateway integration
Mobile-responsive design across various device types
Integration with existing restaurant POS systems
architecture_requirements: Caching strategy for menu and pricing data
CDN integration for static asset delivery

requirements_pool.requirement: MUST support simultaneous ordering from tablet, mobile app, and QR code channels with real-time synchronization
acceptance_criteria: Orders placed on any channel appear instantly on kitchen display
Inventory updates propagate to all channels within 2 seconds
System handles 1000+ concurrent users without performance degradation

requirements_pool.requirement: MUST provide dynamic menu display with filtering capabilities for dietary restrictions and preferences
acceptance_criteria: Filter by allergens, dietary types, price range, cuisine type
Menu items load within 3 seconds
Filter results update instantly without page refresh

requirements_pool.requirement: MUST support complex item customization with real-time price calculation
acceptance_criteria: Price updates within 500ms of customization change
Support nested customization options (size -> toppings -> preparation)
Maintain pricing history for audit purposes

requirements_pool.requirement: MUST provide real-time inventory tracking with automatic item disabling
acceptance_criteria: Inventory updates across all channels within 2 seconds
Automatic suggestions for out-of-stock items
Integration with supplier systems for reorder triggers

requirements_pool.requirement: MUST support multiple payment methods including split payments and tipping
acceptance_criteria: Support credit/debit cards, mobile wallets, cash
Split payment across up to 4 different methods
PCI DSS compliance for secure payment processing

requirements_pool.requirement: SHOULD provide personalized recommendations based on order history and preferences
acceptance_criteria: Machine learning algorithm for recommendation engine
User preference learning from past orders
A/B testing framework for recommendation optimization

requirements_pool.requirement: SHOULD provide comprehensive analytics dashboard for restaurant managers
acceptance_criteria: Real-time sales reporting
Inventory turnover analysis
Customer behavior insights
Peak time analysis and staffing recommendations

requirements_pool.requirement: SHOULD integrate with popular POS systems and third-party delivery platforms
acceptance_criteria: API connections to Toast, Square, Clover POS systems
Integration with DoorDash, Uber Eats APIs
Automated order forwarding to kitchen display systems

requirements_pool.requirement: MAY include voice ordering capability through smart devices
acceptance_criteria: Integration with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant
Voice recognition for menu item selection
Confirmation workflow for voice orders

requirements_pool.requirement: MAY provide built-in loyalty program with points and rewards
acceptance_criteria: Points accumulation based on order value
Tiered reward system with exclusive offers
Integration with email marketing campaigns

design_principles: Intuitive navigation with minimal clicks to order

key_screens.description: Entry point with table number input or QR code scan
Main menu display with filtering and search
key_elements: Shopping cart icon with item count

key_screens.description: Detailed item view with customization options

open_questions.impact: Affects customer satisfaction and inventory management strategy

open_questions.impact: Affects system reliability and customer experience continuity

customer_preferences.tablet_ordering: 60% willing to use tablets for ordering, 65% for payment

95% of restaurant owners report technology improves efficiency
Direct ordering customers spend 35% more than third-party app users
75% of US restaurant traffic involves takeout
Platform-to-consumer segment dominates with 71% revenue share

primary_kpis.measurement: Percentage of orders fulfilled without errors
Comparison of AOV before and after system implementation
Time from order placement to kitchen ticket generation

secondary_kpis.measurement: Percentage of orders placed via mobile app
Orders processed per staff member per hour

deliverables: Core ordering system with basic customization

risk_assessment.risk: High complexity of pricing engine causing performance issues
risk_assessment.mitigation: Implement caching strategy and optimize database queries

risk_assessment.risk: Integration challenges with existing POS systems
risk_assessment.mitigation: Develop standardized API adapters and extensive testing

risk_assessment.risk: Customer resistance to new ordering channels
risk_assessment.mitigation: Comprehensive staff training and gradual rollout strategy
PCI DSS compliance and regular security audits
